summary: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release regarding new preclinical data for opaganib presented at the AACR 2026 annual meeting. The data showed opaganib enhanced chemotherapy efficacy in neuroblastoma models and augmented anti-tumor immunity in triple-negative breast cancer models. No financial terms, transaction structures, board recommendations, or strategic actions were disclosed. This is a routine research update by a foreign private issuer and does not constitute a special situation event.
